messages:
Alyssa (marketing): Quick ask — we need a short, auditable benchpack for the launch post. Can eng/runtime run a focused rerun comparing 13B quantized variants vs fp16 baseline? Need methodology checklist, exact artifacts we should expect (latency heatmap, token-level cost CSV, a handful of raw sample outputs), and a reproducible trace link. Target: slides by Fri, want to lock numbers tomorrow morning.

Ravi (runtime): Quick clarifying Qs — which exact model IDs (we have multiple q4 variants), and which sequence lengths? Also: do you want cold-start (cold VM) numbers, warmed hosts, or both? Any constraints on payloads (seeded vs random)?

Kai (eng-runtime): We can run this. Suggested plan: models = [redwood-13b-q4_0, redwood-13b-q4_1, redwood-13b-fp16]. Seq lengths = 64, 256, 1024. Run both cold and warm (cold=full restart, warm=KV warmed). Payload: CSV with columns prompt_id,prompt,expected_tokens (<=500 rows). Repeats: 3 seeds (1,2,3). Artifacts to deliver: percentile latency CSV (p50/p90/p99), heatmaps by seq len, per-token cost CSV, raw outputs for first 200 tokens (anonymized), run config JSON, and run.log. ETA: ~48h after payload lands.

Alyssa (marketing): I'll assemble the payload CSV and include two canonical examples (short, long). Also we need a short "how to reproduce" snippet for the press appendix — something ops can paste.

Kai (eng-runtime): Got it. Repro snippet (paste into appendix):
```bash
bench-run \\\--model redwood-13b-fp16 \\\--payload payload.csv \\\--warmup 128 \\\--repeats 3 \\\--seed 1 \\\--output /artifacts/run-1767894321\/
```
(Replace model, seed as needed.)

Marta (marketing-ops): Small ask — please include a label mapping file we can use in slides (e.g., "13B quantized (Q4_0)" vs "13B fp16"). Also can we get a CSV with 4 representative prompt->output pairs (short, long, code-ish, conversational) for slide screenshots?

Ravi (runtime): Noted. We'll also run one variant with prefix caching enabled to show cache delta. Tagging bench-bot to queue run when payload is uploaded.

bench-bot: uploaded payload detected at gs://redwood-bench/marketing/1767894321/payload.csv — queuing run. start_ts=1767894350

Kai (eng-runtime): Started job run-2026-03-15-001 (models: redwood-13b-fp16, redwood-13b-q4_0, redwood-13b-q4_1). Job link: https://artifacts.redwood/run-2026-03-15-001 . Will post artifacts and a short variance note if noise > 5% across seeds.

Alyssa (marketing): Amazing — thanks team. If the first sweep looks noisy please surface a variance-probe and we can deprioritize any claim. Keep me posted :pray:
